title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame $$'song_{sample'}$$ contains columns for song title, artist, genre, and streams. The 'streams' column is the target variable, and 'genre' is used to create features.

title: Feature Engineering Process
text: The code snippet creates binary features for each unique genre in the 'genre' column. This is a common technique called one-hot encoding.

title: Model Fitting
text: The LinearRegression model is fitted without an intercept. This means the solution is unique if the feature matrix is full rank.

hintAnswer: The feature matrix is full rank if all columns are linearly independent.
